dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: There are so many different kinds of enemies here. We have to think carefully about how to allocate our troops.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: If you'd like, I can help you analyze the situation, and make some strategic suggestions.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Or... I could even write a few directives for you. Of course, whether or not they get used... hehe, well, that'll be your decision.
